selection: Explicit allowlist of ten completed directories; no glob-based future inclusion.
retained: exact frozen grade decisions with path normalization
public final answer and submitted prompt
Read call order and original native line numbers
read result status, complete-file line counts and content hashes
installed public Skill snapshots by revision
configuration, project preservation inventories, timings and CLI cost estimates
SHA-256 of each local source file
omitted: all model private-reasoning blocks, signatures and reasoning-token event bodies
raw native full streams and arbitrary raw tool-result bodies
session IDs, opaque tool IDs, machine paths, unrelated environment/configuration and credentials
substitutions: workspace absolute prefix becomes <workspace> in prompt/final/grades
Read errors become EISDIR or NOT_FOUND category plus source text hash
successful Read bodies are represented by hashes/line counts and links to the exact public Skill/input documents
integrity_limits: Source hashes identify local originals but do not authenticate collection or make unpublished raw files independently available. Public copies are normalized derivatives, not raw traces. The collector recomputes every project file against before/after inventories and verifies complete returned file contents before export.
privacy_checks: Allowlisted fields only; reject machine-path patterns, private stream keys and credential-shaped strings before any write. No environment or credential file is read.
